description.zh:
资源夹名称。

长度为1~24个字符或汉字，可包含汉字、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the folder.

The name must be 1 to 24 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), periods (.),and hyphens (-).
The ID of the parent folder.
The tag to add to the folder.

descriptions.zh: 最多支持创建5级资源夹。
descriptions.en: A maximum of five levels of folders can be created under the Root folder.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster create-folder --parent-folder-id r-b10000 --folder-name rdFolder --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster CreateFolder --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key k1 --Tag.1.Value v1 --FolderName rdFolder --ParentFolderId 'r-b10000' --method POST --force
